findings.detail: The strict release resolves four reviewed BINDING GDPR evidence references through one hash-bound receipt.
The deterministic preview is valid for one knowledge note and one bilingual question; the active vault remains unchanged.
The release adds only rights routing content and does not modify existing DPIA/FRIA notes, taxonomy, contracts, prompts or sources.
Current legal currency remains unknown and must be considered by the human approver.
Approval is required for this exact candidate before integration.
